name: FFS_SP_RUN_LOG
description: Used to store a history of routing plan runs.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the log record. In the case of scheduling runs, the filed is the run ID. The field is the primary key.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the operation that is logged. Possible values are 'routing', 'rollback', and 'move to bucket'.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource (bucket) where the scheduling run was launched. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_RESOURCE.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_LOG_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the sequence of runs. In the case of sequential runs the ID equals to the ID of the first run in the sequence.

columns.name: PREDECESSOR_LOG_ID
columns.description: Equals to the scheduling plan ID of the previous run in the sequence. If it is single scheduling run, it equals to zero.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_LOG_ID
columns.description: Equals to the scheduling plan ID of the next run in the sequence. If it is single scheduling run, it equals to zero.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Scheduling plan ID that the run belongs to. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_SCHEDULING_PLAN.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Who column: identifier of the action which is assigned by the Application server.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who column: identifier of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: RUN_DATE
columns.description: Date when scheduling run was launched. The date corresponds to the local time zone.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE_START
columns.description: Date the scheduling run was launched for. The date corresponds to the local time zone.

columns.name: STARTED
columns.description: UTC timestamp when exactly the scheduling run was launched.

columns.name: FINISHED
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the scheduling run was actually completed. The difference between FINISHED and STARTED equals to the total duration of the scheduling run that includes all processing steps and infrastructure delays.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TZ_DIFF
columns.description: Time shift between UTC and local time zone for the resource (bucket) where the scheduling run was launched.

columns.name: FILTERS
columns.description: List of filters that the scheduling run passed.

columns.name: TOTAL_RESOURCES
columns.description: Total number of field resources that were sent to the scheduling engine for optimization.

columns.name: RESOURCES_CHANGED_ROUTES
columns.description: The number of field resources that have their routes changed after the scheduling run.

columns.name: ACTIVITIES_TO_BE_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Total number of activities that have to be assigned by the scheduling run.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: Actual number of activities were assigned by the scheduling run.

columns.name: NOT_ASSIGNED_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: Total number of activities were not assigned by the scheduling run due to different reasons. More details on the activities are provided in the table FFS_SP_RUN_LOG_DETAILS.

columns.name: NOT_ASSIGNED_DYNAMIC_SCHED
columns.description: Number of activities were not assigned due to the dynamic scheduling.

columns.name: OPTIMIZATION_FUNCTION_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the optimization function that were reached in the scheduling run.

columns.name: ASSURANCE
columns.description: Actual assurance of the scheduling run result. The assurance varies from 0 to 99 where 99 means the optimal solution is found.

columns.name: RESULT_STATUS
columns.description: Status Of The Scheduling Run. Possible Values Are 'Succeeded', 'Failed', 'Running', 'Stopped', 'Waiting'.

columns.name: RESULT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Additional information about the scheduling run result. For example, in the case of the failed run, it contains the reason of the failure. For succeeded runs, it points if the reoptimization was allowed, or if the reoptimization was accepted.

columns.name: RESULT_DETAILS
columns.description: Details on scheduling run result in xml-format.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE_END
columns.description: End date for the multiday routing: multiday routing covers dates from ROUTE_DATE_START to ROUTE_DATE_END including both of them. In the case of the single day routing ROUTE_DATE_END is the same as ROUTE_DATE_START.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: The priority level of the scheduling run.

columns.name: SLT_TIME
columns.description: Time that the run actually spent at SLT service, seconds.

columns.name: SCHED_RUN_TIME
columns.description: Time that the run actually spent at the scheduling engine, seconds.

columns.name: SCHED_RUN_TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Time limit for the scheduling run duration, seconds.

columns.name: PREDICT_SCHED_RUN_TIME
columns.description: Predicted full run time of the scheduling run, seconds.

columns.name: ACTUAL_SCHED_RUN_STRATUP_TIME
columns.description: Actual start up time of the scheduling run, seconds.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FULL_TIME
columns.description: Actual full run time including start up and processing time of the scheduling run, seconds.

columns.name: EVENT_FIELDS
columns.description: Fields to be exported in the routingRun event and Daily Export.

columns.name: ROLLBACK_LOG_ID
columns.description: Scheduling run ID which were rolled back.

columns.name: STARTUP_MODE
columns.description: Startup Mode For Continuous Routing Plans.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
